decks.module: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions
decks.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way

cards.front: Complete the rule: Idaho's basic speed rule requires a reasonable and.
cards.back: Idaho's basic speed rule requires a reasonable and prudent speed at all times, including roads with legal or posted maximum and minimum limits.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Choose speed with regard to other traffic, pedestrians.
cards.back: Choose speed with regard to other traffic, pedestrians, bicycles, road surface, intersection hazards, visibility, oncoming traffic and curves.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Driving too slowly for existing conditions while impeding.
cards.back: Driving too slowly for existing conditions while impeding safe traffic flow violates the basic speed rule even below the posted limit.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook's interstate maximum is seventy-five miles.
cards.back: The handbook's interstate maximum is seventy-five miles an hour unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: An interstate limit of eighty miles an.
cards.back: An interstate limit of eighty miles an hour may be allowed where it is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: The stated state-highway maximum is sixty-five miles.
cards.back: The stated state-highway maximum is sixty-five miles an hour, with seventy allowed where posted.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: The maximum in a residential, business or urban.
cards.back: The maximum in a residential, business or urban district is thirty-five miles an hour unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not drive so slowly.
cards.back: Do not drive so slowly that normal traffic flow is disrupted.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not remain in the extreme left lane.
cards.back: Do not remain in the extreme left lane in a way that impedes traffic traveling at a lawful speed.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Obey the posted speed.
cards.back: Obey the posted speed limit in a school zone.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Obey posted speed limits.
cards.back: Obey posted speed limits in designated work zones.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

cards.front: Complete the rule: A work-zone speed violation may.
cards.back: A work-zone speed violation may result in an enhanced fixed penalty.
cards.memory_hook: Apply safe speeds and posted exceptions

decks.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way

cards.front: Complete the rule: A flashing red indication requires stopping.
cards.back: A flashing red indication requires stopping and is treated like a stop sign.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: A steady red arrow requires a stop and.
cards.back: A steady red arrow requires a stop and forbids a turn in the arrow's direction until a green or yellow indication allows it.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a steady circular red signal, stop.
cards.back: At a steady circular red signal, stop completely and remain behind the stop line.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: If there is no stop line at a.
cards.back: If there is no stop line at a steady circular red signal, stop before entering the crosswalk.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: A green arrow displayed with a steady red.
cards.back: A green arrow displayed with a steady red indication permits movement only in the green arrow's direction.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: Except for a permitted red-light turn or movement.
cards.back: Except for a permitted red-light turn or movement authorized by a green arrow, wait for green before proceeding from a steady circular red.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: At an intersection, stop or slow as needed.
cards.back: At an intersection, stop or slow as needed to yield to a pedestrian within a marked or unmarked crosswalk.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop at a railway crossing for an approaching.
cards.back: Stop at a railway crossing for an approaching train or when a wigwag, flashing signal, gate or watchman indicates that a train is approaching.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before joining a street from a private road.
cards.back: Before joining a street from a private road, driveway, building or alley, stop short of the sidewalk and yield to both pedestrians and other traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop when a.
cards.back: Stop when a police officer requests it.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: For an emergency or police vehicle using a.
cards.back: For an emergency or police vehicle using a siren or flashing red or blue lights, pull to the nearest right edge or curb clear of intersections and stay stopped until it passes or an officer permits movement.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop when involved.
cards.back: Stop when involved in a crash.
cards.memory_hook: Apply signal and emergency stops

decks.module: Stop for school buses and keep space
decks.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a school bus loading or unloading students.
cards.back: For a school bus loading or unloading students, stop and remain stopped while its upper red lights flash or its stop arm is extended, except for opposite-direction traffic on a highway with four or more lanes and two lanes in each direction.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver who has to stop for a.
cards.back: A driver who has to stop for a school bus cannot move on until every child is clear of both the bus and the roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: Opposite-direction traffic need not stop for the school.
cards.back: Opposite-direction traffic need not stop for the school bus on a highway with four or more lanes when two lanes go in each direction.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: When slowing or stopping, signal other drivers using.
cards.back: When slowing or stopping, signal other drivers using the rear brake-operated lights or an arm signal.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: Travel speed affects the available reaction.
cards.back: Travel speed affects the available reaction time and the time needed to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: When stopped behind another vehicle, a safe habit.
cards.back: When stopped behind another vehicle, a safe habit is to leave enough space to see where its rear tires touch the ground.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: Leaving the recommended stopped-vehicle gap may prevent striking.
cards.back: Leaving the recommended stopped-vehicle gap may prevent striking the vehicle ahead if another vehicle hits from behind.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

cards.front: Complete the rule: The recommended stopped-vehicle gap may provide room to.
cards.back: The recommended stopped-vehicle gap may provide room to go around a stalled vehicle without backing into a traffic hazard.
cards.memory_hook: Stop for school buses and keep

decks.module: Signal with correct timing and position
decks.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use a turn signal when.
cards.back: Use a turn signal when changing lanes or passing another vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use a turn signal.
cards.back: Use a turn signal when leaving a roundabout.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Signal a turn at an.
cards.back: Signal a turn at an intersection or into a driveway.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use a turn signal when entering.
cards.back: Use a turn signal when entering or leaving a freeway or interstate highway.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Signal when pulling from a parked.
cards.back: Signal when pulling from a parked roadside position into the traffic lane.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Signal before pulling over to.
cards.back: Signal before pulling over to the side of the road.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: In a business or residential area, signal at.
cards.back: In a business or residential area, signal at least one hundred feet before a turn or lane change, except that a turn just beyond an intersection is signaled after passing through it.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a freeway or highway, signal at least.
cards.back: On a freeway or highway, signal at least five seconds before a turn or lane change, except that a turn just beyond an intersection is signaled after passing through it.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a turn planned just beyond an intersection.
cards.back: For a turn planned just beyond an intersection, signal after going through that intersection to avoid confusing other drivers.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver may use electric.
cards.back: A driver may use electric turn signals or arm signals.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Extending the arm and hand straight.
cards.back: Extending the arm and hand straight out the window signals a left turn.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Extending the arm and hand upward.
cards.back: Extending the arm and hand upward out the window signals a right turn.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Extending the arm and hand downward.
cards.back: Extending the arm and hand downward out the window signals slowing or stopping.
cards.memory_hook: Signal with correct timing and position

decks.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a right turn, signal and approach in.
cards.back: For a right turn, signal and approach in the right lane as close to the curb as reasonably possible.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before turning right, yield to pedestrians and.
cards.back: Before turning right, yield to pedestrians and vehicles that have the right of way.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before turning right, watch for bicycles approaching.
cards.back: Before turning right, watch for bicycles approaching between the vehicle's right side and the curb.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Complete a right turn into the.
cards.back: Complete a right turn into the cross street's right lane without swinging wide.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a left turn, signal and approach in.
cards.back: For a left turn, signal and approach in the farthest-left lane open to traffic moving in the driver's direction.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a two-lane road, a driver preparing to.
cards.back: On a two-lane road, a driver preparing to turn left should move to the left side of the current lane.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before a left turn, yield.
cards.back: Before a left turn, yield to pedestrians and oncoming vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: When safe, complete a left turn into the.
cards.back: When safe, complete a left turn into the nearest lane carrying traffic in the intended direction without cutting the corner.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a steady red light, a right turn.
cards.back: At a steady red light, a right turn may be made after stopping and yielding to cross-traffic and pedestrians with the right of way, unless signs prohibit the turn.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: A left turn from a one-way street onto.
cards.back: A left turn from a one-way street onto another one-way street may be made on steady red after stopping and yielding to cross-traffic and pedestrians, unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: A posted No U-turn.
cards.back: A posted No U-turn sign prohibits making a U-turn.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not make a U-turn on a curve.
cards.back: Do not make a U-turn on a curve or near or approaching a hillcrest where approaching drivers from either direction cannot see the vehicle within five hundred feet.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: A U-turn is prohibited.
cards.back: A U-turn is prohibited in a no-passing zone.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop and yield to all.
cards.back: Stop and yield to all traffic before completing a U-turn.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Solid markings in the road's center.
cards.back: Solid markings in the road's center indicate that a U-turn is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a permitted U-turn using the handbook's procedure.
cards.back: For a permitted U-turn using the handbook's procedure, first move to the far-right edge of the road and stop.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: In the handbook’s U-turn procedure, check ahead, behind.
cards.back: In the handbook’s U-turn procedure, check ahead, behind and the blind spot to the left rear; if the path is clear, signal and steer sharply left at low speed.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: Once the vehicle points in the intended direction.
cards.back: Once the vehicle points in the intended direction during the stated U-turn procedure, check behind again and accelerate to traffic speed.
cards.memory_hook: Turn with the stated conditions

decks.module: Keep right and apply yielding priorities
decks.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way

cards.front: Complete the rule: The general keep-right rule has stated exceptions for.
cards.back: The general keep-right rule has stated exceptions for left-turn preparation, same-direction passing, a designated slow-traffic lane on a highway with more than two lanes, temporary hazard avoidance, one-way roads and multiple same-direction lanes.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: Preparing for a left turn is.
cards.back: Preparing for a left turn is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing another vehicle traveling in the same direction.
cards.back: Passing another vehicle traveling in the same direction is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: The keep-far-right rule has an exception on a.
cards.back: The keep-far-right rule has an exception on a highway with more than two lanes when the right lane is designated for slow traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: Temporarily entering the left lane to avoid an.
cards.back: Temporarily entering the left lane to avoid an obstruction, pedestrian or animal is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: A road restricted to one-way traffic is.
cards.back: A road restricted to one-way traffic is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: A road with at least two lanes moving.
cards.back: A road with at least two lanes moving in the same direction is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: Motor vehicles must yield to a pedestrian.
cards.back: Motor vehicles must yield to a pedestrian within a marked or unmarked intersection crosswalk.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle entering a street from an.
cards.back: A vehicle entering a street from an alley or driveway must yield to pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: Motor vehicles must yield to a blind pedestrian.
cards.back: Motor vehicles must yield to a blind pedestrian walking with a white cane or a guide dog.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: A pedestrian crossing away from both a crosswalk.
cards.back: A pedestrian crossing away from both a crosswalk and an intersection must yield to motor vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: A pedestrian must yield to motor vehicles when.
cards.back: A pedestrian must yield to motor vehicles when an intersection or crosswalk signal directs that yielding.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: When approaching a Yield sign, slow down, be.
cards.back: When approaching a Yield sign, slow down, be ready to stop and yield to other drivers.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: After stopping to enter a street from an.
cards.back: After stopping to enter a street from an alley, driveway or garage, yield to other drivers.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: After stopping at a.
cards.back: After stopping at a two-way stop, yield to cross-traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a four-way stop, the first vehicle.
cards.back: At a four-way stop, the first vehicle to arrive has the right of way.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: If two vehicles reach a four-way stop together.
cards.back: If two vehicles reach a four-way stop together, the vehicle on the left must yield to the one on the right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: At an intersection with no signs or signals.
cards.back: At an intersection with no signs or signals, simultaneous arrivals require the driver on the left to yield to the driver on the right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.front: Complete the rule: At an uncontrolled T-intersection where the driver must.
cards.back: At an uncontrolled T-intersection where the driver must turn left or right, the handbook requires stopping, yielding, or both for traffic approaching from the other two directions.
cards.memory_hook: Keep right and apply yielding priorities

cards.back: Vehicle racing, speed exhibitions and speed contests are illegal on public roads, streets and highways.

cards.back: The handbook warns that excessive speed contributes to crashes and can combine dangerously with other violations, mechanical failures or judgment errors.
